summary: Moggill Road clearway kerb beside bush; no verge, no parking.

drivers.seclusion: Bush bank to the north; nearest buildings 39 m and beyond, none dwellings.
drivers.access_and_room: Bush and a drain edge the lane; no pull-off or verge wide enough for a van.
drivers.traffic: Busy dual carriageway with live traffic beside the line.
drivers.convention: Clearway repeater sign at the kerb and no parked cars.

flags: Clearway sign, bi-directional, times not given
sun_shade: Bush and slope on the north side; open sky to the south.
